programme.title: Deltas of the World
programme.desc: The journey leads through one of the most fascinating delta landscapes in the world. Starting in the untouched jungle of the Tumucumaque in the north of the Amazon delta, the journey continues south by boat across the 30 kilometre wide river to the Ilha de Maraj. The largest river island in the world, as large as Switzerland, is surrounded by wide beaches, mangrove forests and floodplain forests. On the island untouched jungle and wet savannah characterise the land. Fishermen and aai farmers live from the fruits of nature on the edge of the numerous river veins and flood plains and the collection of medicinal plants serves here, far away from civilization, as a living for the people. On the south side of the delta in the city of Belem we explore the exotic world of the famous Ver-o-Peso market with its impressive variety of fish, tropical fruits, spices and medicinal herbs.

programme.title: Don Friesen
programme.desc: Husband. Idiot. Dad. His kids think he's fun. His wife thinks he's an idiot. Audiences think he's hilarious! Don is a modern suburban dad just trying to raise his kids and get through the day with a bit of money in the bank and a scrap of dignity intact. With a unique style that can best be described as frenetic and engaging, Don captures the irony of parenting, marriage and everyday absurdities through characters, voices, parodies and some of the best written routines around. He's a wanna-be geek who constantly upgrades to the latest technology, but can never get it to work, leading to signature bits about tech support, Idiots Guides, texting and passwords. Friesen has recently taken his smart, savvy, and highly-caffeinated comedy to the stage at the Alex Theatre in Glendale, CA, for the taping of his new Showtime one-hour special titled "Ask Your Mom." In his first nationally released concert special, Don delivers a winning hour of clever, true-to-life "he's talking about my family up there" comedy that manages to be adult-smart yet family-friendly.

programme.title: Andy Woodhull
programme.desc: Andy recently appeared on Conan on TBS. Around that same time, his half-hour special premiered on Comedy Central. He was the first comedian to make his network television debut on “The Tonight Show starring Jimmy Fallon”. He also appeared on Comics Unleashed with Byron Allen, and Gotham Comedy Live on AXS. He had also appeared on Comedy Central's “Live at Gotham” in 2009.

programme.title: Cory Michaelis
programme.desc: A teacher by day and comic by night, Cory Michaelis keeps his act edgy enough to keep the audience from feeling like they're in his 10th grade History class. He cleverly tells short stories and jokes that try to get audiences to think but are silly and absurd as well. Cory is a regular in all of the clubs in the Pacific Northwest and has headlined clubs, colleges, casinos, and weird bars all over the country. He didn't win the 2013 World Series of Comedy (semi-finals), the 2012 Seattle International Comedy Competition (SICC), or the 2014 Tacoma Comedy Contest (2nd) but he took another crack at the SICC and made the 2014 finals.

programme.title: Kristin Key
programme.desc: Kristin Key grew up a minister's daughter in a small town in West Texas. Much like Footloose, she was raised in a no-drinking, no-dancing, no instrumental music environment. She seemed like any other well-behaved girl… until she opened her mouth. It was obvious from the beginning that she had a quick wit and undeniable sense of humor.

programme.title: Tommy Drake
programme.desc: Tommy's unique mixture of original material delivered in a classic style has given him the opportunity to do more shows and be seen by more people live than just about any other comic on the planet.

programme.title: Chad Thornsberry
programme.desc: Chad Thornsberry was born in St. Louis, MO. From an early age he learned his family was blessed, and blessed him with humor, quick wit, and a love of storytelling. Chad's unique comedic perspective awards audience the opportunity to laugh at the common occurrences in everyday life. Often referred to as a great writer, his straightforward style allows audiences to laugh with him and at him as they find the humor in themselves. With reflections on growing up in a trailer park and observations as an English teacher, Chad's satiric insights look at the pitfalls that make us human. With smart humor and a conversational style, Chad has delighted audiences from the trailer park, throughout the Midwest, and from coast to coast.

programme.desc: After a food raid goes wrong the monkey catcher strikes, a handful of the gang are captured and taken away in his van.

programme.desc: The captured monkeys are released in the unknown wilderness while the rest of the gang target a car full of shopping.

programme.desc: The drought means the monkey troop are facing starvation, but they are saved in the nick of time when a devout Hindu brings them bagful’s of fruit and treats.

programme.desc: The monsoon finally breaks, signaling the end of the drought and the beginning of a season of plenty, leading to celebrations from monkeys and people alike!

programme.desc: As India’s government clamps down on marauding macaques in the capital, Delhi, the troublemaker Zamir steals ice cream from a child, bringing the country’s leading monkey catcher racing back to Jaipur.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "Return of the Rebel"
programme.desc: Cunning Zamir finds himself a new troop to join, while little Kavi is prepared for release back onto Jaipur’s streets.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "The Great Escape"
programme.desc: Kavi is released and disappears into the city, whilst Zamir and his new gang raid an office. The monkey catcher traps the troop’s alpha male, Vasu, leaving Zamir set for leadership.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "Trading Places"
programme.desc: Zamir and his new troop raid a jewelry store and break into a hotel store room leading to a run-in with little Kavi, who becomes the troop’s latest recruit.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "Rising Forces"
programme.desc: Policing langurs patrol Delhi’s streets and the Holi festival of colour interrupts Zamir’s attempt to take over control of Galta temple.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "Heroes and Villains"
programme.desc: Esha gets lost and Kavi finds his way back to the Galta gang at last. Zamir’s army attacks the Temple and Tarak is seriously injured in the battle.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "A New Dawn"
programme.desc: Tarak is found dead and Kamal faces the prospect of leading the Galta Gang. Zamir attack's the temple again but is finally caught by the monkey catcher. New babies are born into the Galta Gang, but Zamir has also left a legacy in the city - twins!

programme.title: Blue Realm S1 - "Humpbacks: From Tonga to Antarctica"
programme.desc: Singing louder than any animal on earth, humpback whales are famous for their haunting songs and jaw-dropping acrobatics. They were hunted to the brink of extinction until a moratorium on killing them was implemented in the 1960s.

programme.title: Blue Realm S1 - "Manatees and Dugongs"
programme.desc: Each year, hundreds of critically endangered manatees are killed in U.S. waters by boats, disease and cold weather. 2006 was the worst year on record for manatee deaths 416 animals perished.

programme.title: Blue Realm S1 - "Toxic Invaders"
programme.desc: They're beautiful - and deadly, with venomous spines that resemble a lion's mane. They're lionfish, a tropical reef species normally found in the Indo-Pacific.

programme.title: Blue Realm S1 - "Reefs of Steel"
programme.desc: Around the globe, thousands of decommissioned naval vessels rot in dockyards. What can you do with these toxic time bombs? One solution is to clean them well, blow them up and sink them!

programme.title: Blue Realm S1 - "Shark Nation"
programme.desc: There's no doubt sharks have an image problem. And they're certainly in trouble globally. The population of some species has declined by more than 90% due to over fishing.

programme.title: Blue Realm S1 - "Deep White"
programme.desc: Believe it or not, many scuba divers want to see great whites up close, and photographers want dramatic shots. But how do you get the sharks to where you want them?

programme.title: Blue Realm S1 - "Lions of the Deep"
programme.desc: Since the 1970's, sea lion populations have declined more than 80% along the North Pacific coast. Scientists at the University of British Columbia and the Vancouver Aquarium are working together to help save Canada's iconic and largest pinniped.

programme.title: Doug to the Rescue S1 - "Puerto Rico Rescue Pups"
programme.desc: Doug is called to Puerto Rico to help old friend and rescue partner, Aja Estro, with the massive stray dog population and hoarding cases across the island.

programme.title: Doug to the Rescue S1 - "Chasing Ghost"
programme.desc: Doug checks in on some of the dogs he's rescued before turning his attention to the high desert outside LA and a boxer who's spent 15 months fending for itself in the wild.

programme.title: Animal Atlas S4 - "30 MPH"
programme.desc: How fast can animals run and fly? Meet the cheetah, horse, peregrine falcon, tortoise, and more in a journey through animal speeds.

programme.title: Animal Atlas S4 - "Who’s A Symbol?"
programme.desc: Discover what animals symbolize, from the lion’s courage and bear’s strength to the bald eagle’s freedom and the kangaroo’s progress.

programme.title: Animal Atlas S4 - "Heads Up!"
programme.desc: What makes a head? Explore familiar primate faces, long alligator snouts, giant octopus heads, and even headless sea jellies.

programme.title: Animal Atlas S4 - "Something’s Fishy!"
programme.desc: Take a look at how fish live, swim, and survive, with a closer look at what makes bony and cartilaginous fish unique.

programme.title: Animal Atlas S4 - "Man’s Best Friend"
programme.desc: Have a closer look at dogs, their amazing senses, breeds, working roles, and wolf ancestry, along with foxes and other wild members of the dog family.

programme.title: Animal Atlas S4 - "Curious Cats"
programme.desc: A look at the cat family, from domestic cat to wild cats, and an investigation into where domestic cats come from and how wild cats hunt.

programme.title: Animal Atlas S4 - "Felids & Canids"
programme.desc: Dogs and cats face off in a comparison of their senses, hunting skills, speed, endurance, and social lives, from packs and prides to solitary hunters.

programme.title: Super Senses 2: Special Forces S1 - "ELITE CORPS"
programme.desc: Survival demands an edge. Witness some of the animals whose elite sensory abilities put them at the top of their game.

programme.title: Super Senses 2: Special Forces S1 - "NAVY SEALS"
programme.desc: In the water, it takes sophisticated navigation systems, fine-tuned reflexes, and high-precision detection methods to survive. These animals have what it takes.

programme.title: Super Senses 2: Special Forces S1 - "PATROL"
programme.desc: Life in the wild is life during wartime, and these animal soldiers have mastered the tactics of surveillance, stealth, and attack.

programme.title: Super Senses 2: Special Forces S1 - "SPECIAL GEAR"
programme.desc: On the savannah, in the forest, or under the sea, the competition never quits. Having the right gear provides more than a fighting chance for success.

programme.title: Super Senses 2: Special Forces S1 - "THE SPECIALISTS"
programme.desc: Within this natural world lie countless hidden worlds, which each animal perceives in its own way, with its own highly tuned senses. These are the Specialists.

programme.title: Super Senses 2: Special Forces S1 - "AIR FORCES"
programme.desc: Some animals have the aerial advantage. They’re the fearless fliers that have the battlefield covered, scoping out the situation with super senses and the right stuff.

programme.title: Blue World S5 - "Tiger Sharks in the Bahamas"

programme.title: Blue World S5 - "Iceland…The World’s Clearest Water"
programme.desc: Blue World travels to Iceland to investigate a giant crack in the ground filled with frigid runoff from melting glaciers. It’s rumored to be the clearest water in the world.

programme.title: Blue World S5 - "Tiger Shark as a Camera Operator"
programme.sub-title: Tiger Shark as a Camera Operator
programme.desc: Blue World joins an expedition to recruit a new camera operator in the form of a 1,000 pound Tiger shark! Working with experienced shark handlers, we place a camera on the dorsal fin of the shark to see what it can film all by itself.

programme.title: Blue World S5 - "Cave Training in the Bahamas"

programme.title: Blue World S5 - "Mayan Underworld (Yucatan, Mexico)"

programme.desc: In the Flower Garden Banks National Marine Sanctuary, Blue World investigates some of the densest coral reefs in the Caribbean as they spawn under cover of darkness.

Irene le comenta a Virginia que Felipe le ofreció ser el padre de su hijo por nacer y Virginia cuestiona la voluntad de su hermana de negarle la paternidad a Leonardo. Julio acude a casa de su abuela, Jimena, para interrogarla sobre su identidad. La mujer le da de largas y no contesta su pregunta.Juan Pablo va al motel donde Carlos Ernesto, Tony y Maribel esperan la hora de viajar al Caribe y le lleva los documentos. Por casualidad, Juan Pablo sube al auto de Carlos Ernesto y el mismo estalla en mil pedazos. Adolfo se congratula de lo bien que ha salido su plan.

Luego, Sol y Alejandro se reencuentran, y aunque Alejandro insiste en no ser el padre de Esperanza, Sol le confirma que nunca ha estado con otro hombre que no sea él. programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.sub-title: La luz la final del túnel
programme.desc: PaniK le quita a Mai todas sus Fichas Estelares, y Yugi jura derrotarlo y recuperarlas. Pero con el Castillo de las Ilusiones Oscuras de PaniK rodeado de una niebla negra, ¿cómo podrá Yugi derrotar a un enemigo que no puede ver?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: A pesar de su asombrosa desventaja, Yugi provoca audazmente a PaniK: "Acabaré contigo en tres turnos". ¿Es un farol de Yugi o tiene ventaja en esta batalla de ingenio?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Kaiba baja al reino para enfrentarse a Pegasus! ¿Ha cambiado Kaiba desde su batalla con Yugi o sigue siendo un duelista despiadado? Una batalla entre el Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules de Kaiba y el Dragón B de Ojos Rojos de Joey tiene las respuestas.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El campo de las almas perdidas: Parte 1
programme.desc: La banda del duelista americano número 1, Bandido Keith, secuestra a Joey y lo lleva a una cueva con un campo de juego en forma de cementerio. Joey se enfrenta a los monstruos zombis de Bandit Keith, que se hacen más fuertes al volver de la tumba.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El campo de las almas perdidas: Parte 2
programme.desc: El último recurso de Joey, su carta de suerte del Mago del Tiempo, fracasa contra los monstruos zombis de Bandit Keith. Su racha de suerte llega a su fin, ¿podrán sus mejores habilidades como duelista y el amor por su hermana impulsarlo a la victoria?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Atrapados en la cueva del laberinto, Yugi y sus amigos encuentran una salida alternativa, pero la puerta está custodiada por los Hermanos Paradox de Pegasus.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y Joey aúnan sus fuerzas y consiguen ahuyentar a los monstruos de sus oponentes, pero las cosas están a punto de cambiar cuando los hermanos Paradox invocan al todopoderoso Guardián de la Puerta, ¡un monstruo que refleja todos los ataques!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y Joey liberan cada uno su monstruo más fuerte, Calavera Invocada y Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos, pero su fuerza palidece en comparación con el tremendo poder del Guardián de la Puerta.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Utilizando la magia del Ojo del Milenio, Pegasus atrapa el alma de Mokuba dentro de una carta ante la mirada de Kaiba. Para ganarse el derecho a desafiar a Pegasus, Kaiba debe vencer primero a Yugi y hacerse con sus Fichas Estelares.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba convoca al Dragón Máximo de Ojos Azules, el monstruo más fuerte del juego compuesto por tres Dragones Blancos de Ojos Azules. Yugi ha perdido todos sus poderosos Monstruos de Duelo, pero un verdadero duelista nunca se rinde.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi comienza a hilar una estrategia para acabar con el Dragón Máximo de Ojos Azules, pero debe decidir si reclama la victoria o le perdona la vida a Kaiba. El corazón de Yugi está dividido.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi ha perdido sus Fichas Estelares y su única oportunidad de salvar al abuelo, y está en shock. ¿Podrá Téa hacer que Yugi recupere la conciencia derrotando a Mai para conseguir sus Fichas Estelares extra y enseñar a Yugi el corazón del duelista?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos entran en el castillo y descubren que Kaiba se está preparado para batirse en duelo con Pegaso y que el alma de Mokuba pende de un hilo. El poder del Ojo del Milenio otorga a Pegaso la capacidad de leer la mente de los demás.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba está indefenso ante la baraja del Mundo de Dibujos Animados de Pegaso y sus habilidades para leer la mente. Al final del duelo, Pegasus aprisiona el alma de Kaiba en una carta, al igual que hizo con el abuelo y Mokuba. Yugi está harto.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Era la noche anterior a la batalla final, ¡y muchas criaturas se agitan! Yugi jura derrocar a Pegaso por el bien de su abuelo. Tristán lidera un grupo de exploración para descubrir los secretos de Pegasus.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Bajo la pesada mirada de Pegasus, Yugi se distrae en su duelo con Mai. Después de cometer errores tácticos tontos y permitir que Mai obtenga una gran ventaja con su Dragón Mascota de Arpía, ¿recuperará Yugi su concentración o sucumbirá a tanta presión?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Mai se ha recuperado de su anterior derrota contra Joey convirtiéndose en una mejor duelista. ¿Ha aprendido Yugi de su derrota contra Kaiba, o la derrota emocional sigue pesando en su corazón? La respuesta está en las cartas.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey busca frenéticamente la carta que le permite entrar en la batalla final, sin darse cuenta de que Bandido Keith se la ha robado. Mientras intenta aceptar el hecho de que Serenity estará ciega para siempre, recibe la ayuda de un nuevo amigo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La baraja Máquina de Bandido Keith obliga a Joey a ponerse a la defensiva. Joey copia la estrategia de Keith para metalizar su Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos. ¿Está asegurada la victoria, o el tramposo Bandido Keith tiene una última carta en la manga?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El mejor amigo, el mejor duelista: Parte 1
programme.desc: Orgulloso de su fuerza como duelista en el juego, Joey desafía a Yugi para tener derecho a enfrentarse a Pegasus.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El mejor amigo, el mejor duelista: Parte 2
programme.desc: Yugi se horroriza cuando Joey utiliza la carta del Mago del Tiempo contra él, ¡la misma carta que él le dio a Joey en señal de amistad!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra Pegasus, el partido del milenio: Parte 1
programme.desc: Yugi se prepara para la batalla definitiva contra Pegaso, las almas del abuelo, Kaiba y Mokuba están en juego. Tristán y Bakura se cuelan en el castillo para encontrar a los hermanos Kaiba. ¿Se volverá a convertir Bakura en su yo malvado?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra Pegasus, el partido del milenio: Parte 2
programme.desc: Pegasus usa la baraja de Dibujos Animados y la capacidad de leer la mente que usó con Kaiba y pone a los monstruos de Yugi en su contra. Yugi pierde la voluntad de luchar. ¿Encerrará Pegaso el alma de Yugi en una carta como hizo con Kaiba?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra Pegasus, el partido del milenio: Parte 3
programme.desc: Yugi ha averiguado cómo contrarrestar la capacidad de leer la mente de Pegasus: Yugi se mueve entre sus dos almas y es capaz de destruir el Mundo Dibujos Animados de Pegasus, pero aún no ha empezado el mortal Juego de las Sombras.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra Pegasus, el partido del milenio: Parte 4
programme.desc: Yugi se desploma agotado bajo el poder paralizante del Juego de Sombras. Sus amigos le gritan desesperados ánimos, pero sus voces no penetran en la esfera de oscuridad. La oportunidad de victoria de Yugi se está esfumando, al igual que su vida.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra Pegasus, el partido del milenio: Parte 5
programme.desc: Pegasus invoca a Perdido, un temible monstruo que consume los Monstruos de Duelo de Yugi. Yugi contraataca con... ¿Kuriboh? ¿La criatura más pequeña y débil del juego? ¿Se ha rendido Yugi o se trata de una última estrategia para obtener la victoria?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La Saga de Pegaso llega a su fin, ¡pero un nuevo viaje está a punto de comenzar! Yugi se encuentra con un misterioso egipcio llamado Shadi que entra en la mente de Yugi con la Llave del Milenio.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos regresan del Reino de los Duelistas y se encuentran con una joven llamada Rebecca que exige que el abuelo le devuelva el Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules. Ha venido a recuperar la carta que el abuelo le robó hace muchos años.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Rebecca cree por equivocación que el abuelo le robó el Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules. Yugi debe defender al Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules para enseñarle que lo que cuenta no es el poder de las cartas, sino el corazón que hay en ellas.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Con sus engaños, el Consejo de Administración de KaibaCorp atrapa a Kaiba dentro de un juego de realidad virtual. Mokuba recluta a Yugi y Joey para liberar a Kaiba de este juego definitivo en el que perder equivale a morir.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La búsqueda de Kaiba continúa con un poco de ayuda de... ¿Mai? Pero, ¿podrán Yugi y sus amigos adaptarse a un mundo virtual en el que las reglas y las estrategias cambian a cada paso?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos rescatan a Kaiba, ¡pero siguen atrapados en el juego! La única salida es superar al Dragón de Cinco Cabezas, pero en el difícil duelo, ¡Joey, Mokuba y Mai pierden todos sus puntos de vida!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Monstruos de la mazmorra de los dados: Parte 1
programme.desc: Un nuevo estudiante, Duke Devlin, derrota a Joey en una partida de Duelo de Monstruos, obligando a Joey a convertirse en su sirviente. Duke obliga a Joey a ponerse un disfraz de perro y lo humilla en público, obligando a Yugi a retar a Duke a un duelo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Monstruos de la mazmorra de los dados: Parte 2
programme.desc: A cambio de la libertad de Joey, Yugi se juega renunciar a los Duelos de Monstruos para siempre. Yugi tiene un comienzo difícil. Todo empeora cuando Duke revela que ha diseñado los Dados Monstruos de la Mazmorra con la ayuda de Pegasus.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Monstruos de la mazmorra de los dados: Parte 3
programme.desc: Yugi utiliza sus habilidades innatas para el juego para dar la vuelta a la tortilla, pero Duke tiene una regla más que mencionar: Todas las criaturas ocupan territorio en el tablero cuadriculado.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Monstruos de la mazmorra de los dados: Parte 4
programme.desc: Después de que el todopoderoso Orgoth el Despiadado de Duke haga trizas a todo el plantel de monstruos de Yugi, a Yugi solo le queda un turno antes de perder todos sus puntos de corazón.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Un adivino misterioso roba el Rompecabezas del Milenio, y Yugi debe derrotarlo en un duelo para recuperarlo. Sin embargo, no se trata de un adivino cualquiera; es un conocido y formidable enemigo del Reino de los Duelistas... ¿o no?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La misteriosa amenaza que controla a Bandido Keith rompe el Rompecabezas del Milenio en pedazos antes de incendiar la arena de duelos. ¿Podrá Yugi recomponer el Rompecabezas del Milenio y salvar al espíritu antes de que las llaman envuelvan toda la sala?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Se revela el origen de Duelo de Monstruos! Utilizando la magia del Collar del Milenio, la historiadora egipcia Ishizu Ishtar muestra a Kaiba cómo se jugaba al Duelo de Monstruos hace milenios.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El espíritu del Rompecabezas del Milenio ve que han desaparecido sus recuerdos del antiguo Egipto, pero Téa le ayudará a descubrir los misterios de su pasado. El duelista Johnny Steps y sus monstruos musicales del rock interrumpirán su búsqueda.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Para afrontar el futuro, Yugi debe mirar el pasado. Yugi fue un poderoso faraón que salvó al mundo hace cinco milenios. Kaiba pone a prueba los poderes ocultos de su carta egipcia Obelisco el Atormentador contra la furia del Dragón Máximo de Ojos Azules.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Acechado por los Cazadores de Rarezas
programme.desc: Un grupo de siniestros Cazadores de Rarezas acorralan a Joey y le obligan a batirse en duelo. Si Joey pierde, los Cazadores de Rarezas se quedan con su Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos. Joey aplasta a sus enemigos, pero hay otros caminos a la victoria.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra el Cazador de Rarezas, Parte 1: Comienza la ciudad de las batallas
programme.desc: Es hora de aprender nuevas reglas y monstruos. ¡Que comience el Torneo de la Ciudad de la Batalla! En el primer duelo del torneo, Yugi desafía al Cazador de Rarezas para recuperar el Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos de Joey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra el Cazador de Rarezas, Parte 2: Contra Exodia
programme.desc: Yugi descubre la estrategia del Cazador de Rarezas para invocar al todopoderoso Exodia, ¡pero es demasiado tarde para detenerlo! El Cazador de Rarezas ya tiene cuatro piezas de Exodia en su mano, y la quinta y última pieza está encima de su mazo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El duelista psíquico Espa Roba derrota a Rex Raptor muy fácilmente, ¡y Joey es el siguiente en su lista de objetivos! ¿Qué posibilidades tiene Joey cuando Espa Roba tiene la capacidad telepática de leer todas las cartas del mazo de Joey?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey descubre que la percepción extrasensorial de Espa Roba es un engaño, ¡pero no se ha librado de sus manipulaciones! El Jinzo de Espa Roba mata a todos los monstruos de Joey y aumenta su poder en cada turno. ¿Ha llegado a su fin la suerte de Joey?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El Maestro de los Magos: Parte 1
programme.desc: Arkana, el mago duelista, transporta a Yugi a la arena de duelo más letal del mundo, donde el perdedor es enviado al Reino de las Sombras. Yugi debe ganar este duelo o perderá mucho más que a su Mago Oscuro.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El Maestro de los Magos: Parte 2
programme.desc: ¡Es Mago Oscuro contra Mago Oscuro! Sin embargo, mientras Yugi solo controla un Mago Oscuro, Arkana tiene tres en su mazo. Aunque le superan en número, Yugi nunca se rendirá, ¡mientras crea en el corazón de las cartas!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El Maestro de los Mago: Parte 3
programme.desc: Para contrarrestar al Mago Oscuro de Arkana, Yugi saca un conejo de su chistera: ¡La Maga Oscura! ¡Es la batalla de los sexos para determinar quién es el verdadero maestro de los magos!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El tramposo Larva Subterráneo teje una red de mentiras para atraer a Joey a un duelo desigual. Larva Subterránea infecta en secreto el mazo de Joey con un parásito que le impide invocar monstruos fuertes.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El tramposo Larva Subterráneo teje una red de mentiras para atraer a Joey a un duelo desigual. Larva Subterránea infecta en secreto el mazo de Joey con un parásito que le impide invocar monstruos fuertes.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey aplasta al Gran Moth Definitivo Perfecto, pero Larva suelta a la feroz Reina de los Insectos, la joya de la corona de los insectos que aumenta su fuerza con cada oruga que canibaliza. ¿Conseguirá la reina devoradora de Larva someter a Joey?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey aplasta al Gran Moth Definitivo Perfecto, pero Larva suelta a la feroz Reina de los Insectos, la joya de la corona de los insectos que aumenta su fuerza con cada oruga que canibaliza. ¿Conseguirá la reina devoradora de Larva someter a Joey?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi se enfrenta a otro de los nefastos Cazadores de Rarezas de Marik: ¡el silencioso pero mortal Cuerdas! Cuerdas bloquea todos los ataques de Yugi con Gelatina Reanimada, un limo resbaladizo que resucita cada vez que lo destruyen.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Cuerdas convoca a una de las criaturas más poderosas de la historia de Duelo de Monstruos... ¡el dios egipcio Slifer el Dragón del Cielo! ¿Qué posibilidades tiene la banda de monstruos mortales de Yugi contra un dios egipcio?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El hechizo Cartas Infinitas permite a Cuerdas tener un número ilimitado de cartas en su mazo, ¡así que Slifer el Dragón del Cielo de Cuerdas puede crecer hasta un poder de ataque infinito!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey se enfrenta al duelista del mar Mako Tsunami y su grupo de bestias submarinas. Si Joey gana, tendrá las seis cartas de localización necesarias para entrar en las finales de Ciudad de las Batallas, pero si pierde, ¡tendrá que despedirse dels finales!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡El guerrero marino de Mako, el Pescador Legendario, desata una ola de destrucción que va destruyendo a los monstruos de Joey! ¡Joey tiene que recurrir a sus habilidades, su entrenamiento y su experiencia antes de que todo se acabe!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Doble duelo. Parte 1: Yugi y Kaiba contra Lumis and Umbra
programme.desc: ¡Los secuestros abundan! Marik, con la ayuda de Bakura, secuestra a Joey y Téa. Además, los Cazadores de Rarezas también secuestran a Mokuba para obligar a Yugi y Kaiba a enfrentarse a los duelistas Umbra y Lumis en lo alto de un rascacielos.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Doble duelo. Parte 2: Yugi y Kaiba contra Lumis and Umbra
programme.desc: Lumis y Umbra destruyen sistemáticamente el caótico trabajo en equipo de Yugi y Kaiba. ¿Podrán Yugi y Kaiba aprender a dejar de lado sus diferencias antes de ser enviados a un viaje sin retorno al Reino de las Sombras?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Doble duelo. Parte 3: Yugi y Kaiba contra Lumis and Umbra
programme.desc: Yugi y Kaiba empiezan a mostrar signos de trabajo en equipo, pero es demasiado poco y demasiado tarde cuando Umbra y Lumis convocan a la Bestia Enmascarada Des Gardius, ¡una monstruosa amenaza aún más poderosa que el Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Doble duelo. Parte 4: Yugi y Kaiba contra Lumis and Umbra
programme.desc: ¡Yugi combina sus monstruos magnéticos en la potencia polar de Valkyrion el Guerrero Magno! Sin embargo, poco sabe Yugi que Umbra y Lumis tienen una última máscara para volver a los monstruos de Yugi contra él.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y Kaiba van en misión de rescate para salvar a sus amigos. Pero en el camino, todas sus preocupaciones y secretos se revelan al revivir los problemas que han enfrentado... ¡y que enfrentarán en el futuro!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El duelo es de amigo contra amigo porque Marik controla mentalmente a Joey para que se bata en duelo contra Yugi. El perdedor será arrastrado al océano. ¿Podrá Yugi liberar a Joey de su hechizo, o será Joey el que acabe con Yugi?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Aunque Joey le ha diezmado sus puntos de vida, Yugi no se atreve a atacar a su querido amigo. Yugi convoca al monstruo favorito de Joey, el Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos, para intentar que Joey recupere la cordura.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi empieza a romper el hechizo de Marik sobre Joey, pero ahora debe batirse en duelo sin el Rompecabezas del Milenio. Cuando Joey roba la carta que necesita para diezmar los puntos de vida de Yugi, ¿qué posibilidades le quedan para ganar?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Solo queda un minuto de duelo para que el perdedor caiga en las profundidades del mar. ¿Se enviarán estos mejores amigos a su perdición? Sin embargo, puede haber una salvadora especial que acaba de recuperar la vista.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Es la batalla de los espectros porque Bakura desata su ejército de fantasmas contra los feroces zombis de Bonz para poder entrar en la final de la Ciudad de la Batalla. Pero, ¿por quién doblará la campana final cuando jueguen en el Reino de las Sombras?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Es un juego de amor porque el rompecorazones de Hollywood, Jean-Claude Magnum, desafía a Mai a un duelo para conseguir su mano. ¿Sucumbirá Mai al encanto de Jean-Claude, por no hablar de su grupo de monstruos ninja?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Que comience la final de la Ciudad de la Batalla! Los ocho finalistas pondrán a prueba su habilidad y resistencia en una arena de duelo a miles de metros de altura.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El espíritu oscuro se revela: Yugi contra Bakura: Parte 1
programme.desc: Es el primer duelo de la final. Yugi se enfrenta al espíritu maligno del Anillo del Milenio que posee a Bakura. Yugi se deshace de los grotescos espectros de Bakura, pero él tiene una estrategia sacada directamente del cementerio…

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El espíritu oscuro se revela: Yugi contra Bakura: Parte 3
programme.desc: Slifer el Dragón del Cielo de Yugi está a punto de dar el golpe final para ganar el duelo, pero Bakura podría no sobrevivir a la explosión del todopoderoso monstruo egipcio.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: La furia de los dioses egipcios
programme.desc: ¡Por fin se revela el origen de las cartas de dioses egipcios! El misterioso Shadi lleva a Yugi a un viaje a través del tiempo hasta la creación de Duelo de Monstruos... ¡y los peligrosos poderes que liberó!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: En el segundo duelo de la final, Odion, disfrazado de Marik, desconcierta a Joey con numerosas trampas para llevar el duelo a un punto muerto. Sin embargo, Joey cuenta con la Tornado Gigante, la contrapartida perfecta que garantiza la victoria de Joey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Las Encarnaciones de Apophis de Odion se ensañan con los monstruos de Joey... ¡y con sus puntos de vida! ¿Podrá Joey utilizar eficazmente los monstruos que ganó antes en el torneo, o está ya demasiado nervioso para montar un contraataque exitoso?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Es un frenesí devorador porque el Serket de Odion devora a los monstruos de Joey para transformarse en poderosas etapas de evolución. ¿Cómo puede Joey derrotar a Serket cuando éste ingiere los monstruos de Joey cada vez que los invoca en el campo?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Odion utiliza una carta de dios egipcio falsa para invocar al tercer monstruo divino egipcio, el Dragón Alado de Ra, y lo utiliza para aniquilar los cinco puntos de vida que le quedan a Joey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Un juego mental: Mai contra Marik: Parte 1
programme.desc: El tercer duelo de la final de la Ciudad de Batalla entre Mai y Marik no es un duelo normal. Es una batalla en el temido Reino de las Sombras donde perder puntos de vida equivale a perder tus recuerdos.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Un juego mental: Mai contra Marik: Parte 2
programme.desc: A medida que Mai pierde cada vez más recuerdos bajo el implacable asalto de Marik, también pierde la confianza en sus habilidades para combatir en duelos.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Un juego mental: Mai contra Marik: Parte 3
programme.desc: Mai se hace con el control del Dragón Alado de Ra de Marik, pero es incapaz de averiguar cómo desatar sus poderosas habilidades.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Un duelo con el destino: Kaiba contra Ishizu: Parte 1
programme.desc: En el cuarto duelo de la final de la Ciudad de Batalla, la misteriosa oponente de Kaiba es... ¡Ishizu! Con el poder de su Collar del Milenio, Ishizu puede ver el futuro. ¡Incluso todas las cartas que Kaiba tiene previsto jugar!
